listed_quote.quote: The Board of Trustees of KKR Income Opportunities Fund (“KIO”) (NYSE: KIO) and the Board of Trustees of Insight Select Income Fund (“INSI”) (NYSE: INSI) today announced the signing of a definitive agreement under which KIO will acquire the assets of INSI.

announcement.quote: KKR Income Opportunities Fund to Acquire Assets of Insight Select Income Fund

deals.notes: Press release dated October 8, 2024, filed as 425 on 2024-10-09. Special meeting first noticed for December 20, 2024, then for January 10, 2025 (N-14/A and DEF 14A of 2024-12-23). Requires approval by both funds' shareholders. No excerpt states the vote result, completion, or termination: the later filings (2025-02-14 and 2026-02-13 DEF 14A annual-meeting trustee elections, 2025-10-31 8-K officer change) do not mention the transaction in the excerpts, so the outcome is left null.
